caption:
Pina Colada Chia Pudding 
vegan friendly | meal prep | sugar free

Nutrition: 
C: 24 | F: 24 | P: 9
Calories: 272 per serve 
Serves 2

Ingredients
1/4 cup chia seeds
1/4 cup coconut milk + 3/4 cup regular milk 
1 tbsp greek yogurt
1 tsp monkfruit or sweetender
1 tsp vanilla extract, optional
1 cup cut pineapple 

Method
add chia + milks + greek yogurt +monkfruit + vanilla to a bowl and mix together 
leave it on the counter for 20 minutes, stir again and then refridgerate (we do this so the chia doesnt clump up which prevents max absorbtion overnight) 
the next morning, layer the pudding with pineapple and enjoy!
